name: candidate-debrief
description: Structure and run a post-interview candidate debrief. Use when the user says "run the debrief", "how do we decide on this candidate", "let's calibrate", "we need to make a hire/no-hire call", "prep the debrief meeting", or wants to structure the decision-making process after interviews are complete - even if they don't explicitly say "debrief". Also use when a recruiter wants to prevent groupthink or HiPPO effect (highest paid person's opinion) from dominating the decision.
